title: Taiwanese American Association Greater Cleveland 克里夫蘭 台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Association Greater Cleveland (克里夫蘭 台灣同鄉會) is the Greater Cleveland chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization for Taiwanese American community associations across the United States. The chapter serves the Taiwanese American community in the greater Cleveland, Ohio area.
